Business-type reported totals are operating + nonoperating added (no single printed total; the Statement of Activities p2 prints total business-type expenses 1,566,666). ending_cash = Cash and cash equivalents 1,043,412 on governmental funds balance sheet (p4); certificates of deposit 1,021,959 in ending_investments; county treasurer cash 16,992 not included. Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position Total primary government column (p1); component unit (CRA) excluded. Detail: General Fund from the more detailed departmental combining statement (pp18-19, ties to General column p5), so the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p14, budget basis) is not recorded to avoid double counting; Street and Airport budgetary comparison schedules (pp15-16, budget basis) and nonmajor combining statement (p17, CDBG and Hospital Bond Sinking). No proprietary fund schedules in the trim. Airport spending has no matching category (recorded as other with review). Read pages 1-19 of 19
